terminology.comparison: Default tools versus Native tools mode
terminology.agent: Same Goose coding loop and primary Gemini 3.8 Flash; no OMP or nested coding agent.

implementation.diagnosticsCaveat: Budget starts after server initialization; missing reports are pending, never proof of clean code. Language-server project graph, config and compiler/tests determine semantic coverage.

release.reason: Simple-task speed gate remains unmet; full v6.1 matrix not requalified. Source and isolated rebuilt candidate are available.

remainingFindings: The mode-on simple-task path still sometimes chooses guarded reads and safe edit/test: five hashline calls and one safe call in one of two focused runs.

Focused mode-on trials made 35 tool calls and 39 provider requests versus 25 and 29 with mode off, including pre-Send title requests. Those counts explain extra round trips but do not isolate schema, provider variation or prompt causality.

AST/LSP integration works in selected benchmark tasks; none were selected in the simple follow-up. Syntax AST filters do not resolve bindings, and LSP coverage depends on the configured project graph.

Two repetitions per task/arm cannot establish statistical speed equivalence, universal reliability or superior quality. This is mode off/on on one rebuilt Goose binary, not a matched pristine upstream Goose or historical 2.4.2 comparison.
Multi-file publication uses advisory locks and durable recovery; it cannot be globally atomic against arbitrary external writers or undo unowned test side effects.
